b9f8663279dd536e0894799d07c0abc9258b9620.LogDescription: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Gnome Spirit in Ironforge's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
b9f8663279dd536e0894799d07c0abc9258b9620.QuestDescription: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.

b9fa746a643b0259b1d8d83f34789285270e7829.OptionText: Your eminence, may I have a word in private?

b9fc780edef7e241e1a80cd4707cc675b72f9462.Text: Nerzhul will never give up. Where are our heroes?

b9fd28cfc12c97ae2cae0ff515385bfa633efdf8.Text: Soon we will eradicate the Alliance and Horde. Then the rest of Azeroth will fall before the might of my army.

b9fd5b2ac16799e8728b46c82fb6d5e69d4f1747.Text: Look at it, Jon. It's glorious!
